commands.name: asyncapi-generate

options.name: --exclude-channel
options.description: Glob patterns for channels to exclude (e.g.  internal/**). Specify multiple times or comma-separate.

options.name: --force
options.description: Force regeneration even if the lock file indicates no  changes.

options.name: --include-channel
options.description: Glob patterns for channels to include (e.g. user/**).  Specify multiple times or comma-separate.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Generation mode: producer, consumer, or both (default: both).

options.name: --outputPath
options.description: The path to which to write the generated code.

options.name: --rootNamespace
options.description: The root namespace for generated types.

options.name: --spec-url
options.description: The original URL of the API description. When set, the spec is fetched from this URL and stored locally. The URL is recorded in the  lock file for update-style re-fetch.

options.name: --specVersion
options.description: The AsyncAPI spec version to use (2.6 or 3.0). If not  specified, auto-detected from the spec.

options.name: --tag
options.description: Filter by operation tags. Only operations with at  least one matching tag are included. Specify multiple times or comma-separate.

options.name: --yaml
options.description: Enable YAML support. When set, the spec file and any  external references may be YAML, JSON, or a mixture. Auto-detected from  .yaml/.yml extensions if not explicitly set.

arguments.name: specFile
arguments.description: The path to the AsyncAPI specification file (JSON or  YAML).

options.name: --addExplicitUsings
options.description: If true, the generate will include using statements  for the standard implicit usings.

options.name: --assertFormat
options.description: Whether to assert 'format' specifications  globally (default true). Pass '--assertFormat false' to generate  annotation-only, where 'format' is recorded but never fails  validation.

options.name: --buildParametersThreshold
options.description: The maximum estimated number of captured value slots  an object type's property-parameter Build(...) overload may hold before it  is omitted. Defaults to 32 when unset.

options.name: --codeGenerationMode
options.description: The code generation mode. TypeGeneration emits  strongly-typed C# types (default). SchemaEvaluationOnly emits a standalone  evaluator for validation and annotation collection. Both emits both.

options.name: --defaultAccessibility
options.description: The default accessibility for generated top-level  types. Supported values: Public, Internal.

options.name: --disableNamingHeuristic
options.description: Disables the specific naming heuristic.

options.name: --disableOptionalNamingHeuristics
options.description: Disables all optional naming heuristics.

options.name: --engine
options.description: The code generation engine to use. V4 uses  Corvus.Json.ExtendedTypes. V5 uses Corvus.Text.Json. Default: V5 for corvusjson, V4 for generatejsonschematypes.

options.name: --formatMode
options.description: Format assertion mode overrides, comma-separated. Use  '<format>=<assert|disable|warning>' for one format (e.g. 'date-time=disable,time=warning'), or a bare  '<assert|disable|warning>' (equivalently  '*=<mode>') to set the default for ALL formats — e.g.  '--formatMode disable' for annotation-only output across every draft.  May be specified more than once. An override takes precedence over the  schema's format vocabulary and --assertFormat.

options.name: --optionalAsNullable
options.description: If NullOrUndefined, optional properties are emitted as .NET nullable values. If NullOrUndefinedExceptNonNullDefaulted, optional  properties with a non-null default are instead emitted as non-nullable values.

options.name: --outputMapFile
options.description: The name to use for a map file which includes details  of the files that were written.

options.name: --outputPath
options.description: The path to which to write the generated code.

options.name: --outputRootAccessibility
options.description: The accessibility for the generated root type when  --outputRootTypeName is specified. Supported values: Public, Internal.

options.name: --outputRootTypeName
options.description: The .NET type name for the root type.

options.name: --rebaseToRootPath
options.description: If a --rootPath is specified, rebase the document as  if it was rooted on the specified element.

options.name: --rootNamespace
options.description: The default root namespace for generated types.

options.name: --rootPath
options.description: The path in the document for the root type.

options.name: --useImplicitOperatorString
options.description: If true, conversion operators to string are implicit,  rather than explicit.

options.name: --useSchema
options.description: Override the fallback schema variant to use. If  NotSpecified, and it cannot be inferred from the schema itself, it will use  Draft2020-12.

options.name: --useUnixLineEndings
options.description: If true, line endings emitted using the Unix style  ('\n'). Otherwise, it uses the Windows style ('\r\n').

options.name: --yaml
options.description: If true, YAML support is enabled. You may use YAML,  JSON or a mixture of such documents.

arguments.name: schemaFile
arguments.description: The path to the schema file to process.

commands.name: openapi-callback-client

options.name: --clientName
options.description: The prefix for generated client type names. Defaults  to the API title.

options.name: --exclude-path
options.description: Glob patterns for paths to exclude (e.g. /admin/**).  Specify multiple times or comma-separate.

options.name: --filter
options.description: (Deprecated: use --include-path) Glob patterns to  filter which paths to include. Comma-separated or specify multiple times.

options.name: --force
options.description: Force regeneration even if the lock file indicates no  changes.

options.name: --group-by
options.description: How to group operations in the output:  'path' (default) or 'tag'.

options.name: --ignoreEmptyFormUrlEncodedBody
options.description: Treat form-urlencoded request bodies whose schema  defines no properties as if the body were absent. Useful for real-world APIs  (e.g. Stripe) that emit empty body definitions.

options.name: --include-path
options.description: Glob patterns for paths to include (e.g. /pets/**).  Specify multiple times or comma-separate.

options.name: --outputPath
options.description: The path to which to write the generated code.

options.name: --rootNamespace
options.description: The root namespace for generated types.

options.name: --spec-url
options.description: The original URL of the API description. When set, the spec is fetched from this URL and stored locally. The URL is recorded in the  lock file for update-style re-fetch.

options.name: --specVersion
options.description: The OpenAPI spec version to use (3.0 or 3.1). If not  specified, auto-detected from the spec.

options.name: --yaml
options.description: Treat the input specification as YAML. If not  specified, YAML is auto-detected from .yaml/.yml file extension.

arguments.name: specFile
arguments.description: The path to the OpenAPI specification file (JSON or  YAML).
